text:
morgan: Heads-up — vendor-jp just notified us about a partial warranty/recall for H100 batch 23-47. They say 12 units flagged, possible thermal sensor drift. Forwarder is asking if we want return-to-vendor (R2V) or depot repair; both have different fee profiles. Can procurement & ops triage?
jess: Thanks. Do we have AWB/manifest yet? Also need ETA for affected edge regions (EU/AMS) so we can prebook slots.
vendor-jp: Hi all — we found a manufacturing run variance. Manifest attached: 
```
AWB: 4876123490
PO: RW-2024-1456
SKU: H100-48GB
Units flagged: 12
Location: FRA depot 3
```
We can do R2V (courier collect) or depot repair (local repair, 3-5 days). R2V has return freight and duty reclaim; depot repair has depot handling fee + test bench charge.
diego: Quick math: R2V -> higher outbound freight and potential import duty reclaim admin, depot repair -> per-unit bench fee ~€220 + spare parts if needed. Which is cheaper depends on repair rate. Do we have vendor repair rate?
vendor-jp: Historically 85% repair pass at depot for this defect. If pass -> depot cheaper. If fail -> vendor issues replacement but R2V transit still applies.
zhen: Operational constraint — FRA depot batch slot is tight next week. If we choose depot repair we need to confirm dock window by EOD tomorrow or we'll hit +48h delay. Also crossdock capacity in AMS is limited; prefer minimal outbound moves.
ops-bot: [shipment-4876123490] current status: ARRIVED FRA-DEPOT-3 2024-11-02 07:18 UTC. Photos uploaded.
samir: From finance — vendor quoting two options: 
- R2V: vendor covers replacement cost; Redwood covers outbound courier (~€1,200) + customs reclaim admin (~€150).
- Depot repair: Redwood pays depot bench €220/unit + vendor covers parts if repairable. Estimated total depot cost = 12 * 220 = €2,640 + handling €300 = ~€2,940.
If 85% repair success, expected cost depot = 0.85*0 (parts covered) + 0.15*(replacement + return freight) -> need replacement cost numbers.
morgan: Replacement list price for H100 is ~€26k/unit but under procurement contract we have replacement credit; ask vendor for replacement cost after warranty. Also confirm if vendor will waive bench fee for warranty cases.
jess: Action items: 1) vendor-jp confirm bench fee waiver or discount for warranty cases, 2) vendor-jp provide replacement cost if repair fails, 3) ops to hold slot tentatively and confirm by EOD, 4) finance to run quick expected-cost calc with probabilistic repair rate.
vendor-jp: 1) bench fee: we can waive bench fee for first 8 units as gesture; remaining units bench fee applies. 2) replacement cost under warranty = zero for confirmed warranty failures. 3) we'll provide a formal fee breakdown by today 18:00 CET.
diego: With that concession, depot repair expected cost = waived for 8 units + 4 * 220 + handling 300 = 4*220 + 300 = 1,180 EUR. Even factoring a fail->replace for 0 units cost to us, depot looks far cheaper and avoids cross-border courier.
zhen: I can hold the FRA dock slot until 18:00 CET; if vendor confirms bench waiver in writing we proceed depot repair. If no confirmation, we fallback to R2V and I need procurement signoff for courier.
morgan: Ping @vendor-jp please send the waiver in writing to procurement@redwood.internal. Include AMEND to PO RW-2024-1456.
vendor-jp: Will send signed amendment within 90 minutes.
ops-bot: [reminder] morgan: Dock hold expires 2024-11-02 18:00 UTC unless confirmed.
samir: Noted — finance will prepare a 2-scenario table (depot vs R2V) and post in this thread by 17:30 CET.
jess: Also can we capture serials now? If depot repair happens we need serial trace for warranty logs. vendor-jp: serial list attached in secure share (link redacted).
morgan: OK — plan tentatively set to depot repair pending written waiver. If anything changes, update here. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
